It is necessary to pay attention to the following points regarding the amended electronic invoice:
1- The invoice type and template, information items related to the buyer, the product/service ID, and the value-added tax rate cannot be amended, and to amend them, a cancellation reference invoice and a new invoice must be issued.
2- To amend the number/amount of each product/service row:
a. In case of increase, for the increased number/amount, in addition to the possibility of issuing a new (original) invoice, a revised invoice can also be issued. (It is not possible to add a new product/service ID to the amended invoice.)
b. In case of reduction, in addition to the possibility of issuing a sales return invoice, a correction invoice can also be issued for the reduced quantity/amount. (This feature can only be used for correction if the quantity/amount is incorrectly recorded in the original invoice.)
3- Issuing a correction invoice on a correction invoice is possible by observing the conditions tated in the documents provided by the system. Obviously, the last approved correction invoice must be considered as the reference invoice.
4- If the reference invoice itself is a correction/sales return, in order to issue a correction/sales return invoice, the reference must be in one of the following statuses (approved/system approved/no response required, no response possible).
